description: The deuteron bar-even/bar-odd split is the SIGNED H₆ partition-conjugation parity, verified against the derived caches (25 dps). CORRECTS an earlier draft that dropped the weight bar-sign. Three facts: I1 w_λ=w_{λ'}; I2 χ^{λ'}(q)=χ^λ(q⁻¹); I3 w_λ(q⁻¹)=(−1)^{n-1}w_λ(q) (=−1 for n=6). Parity map T_λ(q⁻¹)=(−1)^{n-1}T_{λ'}(q)=−T_{λ'}(q) (all 11). CORRECTED key fact: the self-conjugate (3,2,1) is BAR-ODD (T(q⁻¹)=−T(q), ratio −1) ⇒ feeds the bar-odd impurity t, NEVER g₂ (opposite of the earlier draft). So the bar-even g₂ is carried by conjugate-pair ASYMMETRIES Δ_λ−Δ_{λ'}, and the bar-odd t by the symmetric parts + the self-conjugate. DERIVED: the signed parity structure (Lean ConjugationParitySplit sorry-free). NOT derived: the Δ_λ magnitudes (Track-A gate) + tr_M→binding normalization. scope-(a), audit-only, nothing wired; no fit.
tier: three exact identities + signed parity map + CORRECTED self-conjugate→t; Lean-proved backbone; no fit
